credential_verified_has_verifier.name: credential_verified_has_verifier
credential_verified_has_verifier.value: "professional_credentials"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("professional_credentials"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "professional_credentials"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

care_log_has_target.name: care_log_has_target
care_log_has_target.value: "care_logs"."cat_id" IS NOT NULL OR "care_logs"."colony_id" IS NOT NULL

help_request_has_target.name: help_request_has_target
help_request_has_target.value: "help_requests"."cat_id" IS NOT NULL OR "help_requests"."colony_id" IS NOT NULL

help_request_resolved_has_note.name: help_request_resolved_has_note
help_request_resolved_has_note.value: "help_requests"."status" <> 'resolved' OR ("help_requests"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "help_requests"."resolution_note" IS NOT NULL)

caregiver_availability_shape.name: caregiver_availability_shape
caregiver_availability_shape.value: ("caregiver_availability"."from_date" IS NOT NULL AND "caregiver_availability"."to_date" IS NOT NULL AND "caregiver_availability"."to_date" >= "caregiver_availability"."from_date") OR "caregiver_availability"."weekly_pattern" IS NOT NULL

caregiver_pricing_shape.name: caregiver_pricing_shape
caregiver_pricing_shape.value: ("caregiver_profiles"."pricing_type" = 'free' AND "caregiver_profiles"."price_minor" IS NULL) OR ("caregiver_profiles"."pricing_type" = 'paid' AND "caregiver_profiles"."price_minor" > 0 AND "caregiver_profiles"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND "caregiver_profiles"."price_unit" IN ('per_day', 'per_visit'))

placement_in_care_after_handover.name: placement_in_care_after_handover
placement_in_care_after_handover.value: "placements"."status" NOT IN ('in_care', 'ended') OR ("placements"."caregiver_handover_at" IS NOT NULL AND "placements"."requester_handover_at" IS NOT NULL)
